title: Eli and His House
lead: The priest at Shiloh who raised Samuel. His sons Hophni and Phinehas abused their office, a man of God announced the end of his house, and Eli died on the day the ark was captured (1 Samuel 1–4).

sections.b: Eli sits by the doorpost of the LORD's house at Shiloh when Hannah prays (1 Samuel 1:9), and he raises her son (1 Samuel 2:11). His sons treat the LORD's offering with contempt (1 Samuel 2:12–17), and two warnings, one from a man of God and one through the boy Samuel, announce that Eli's line will lose the priesthood (1 Samuel 2:27–36; 1 Samuel 3:11–14). Hophni and Phinehas die in battle, the ark is taken, Eli falls and dies, and his grandson is named Ichabod, "Where is the glory?" (1 Samuel 4). His descendants serve as priests at Nob until Saul kills them (1 Samuel 22), and Abiathar, the one who escapes, is finally sent away by Solomon in favor of Zadok. The narrator says this made the LORD's word about Eli's house come true (1 Kings 2:27).
